judgments.rationale: The proposal modifies the summary to require that inspections under item (II) occur 'not more than once during any 12-month period'. In the source text, item (I) ('not more than once during any 12-month period') and item (II) ('at any time with respect to records relating to a firearm involved in a criminal investigation that is traced to the licensee') are disjunctive alternatives joined by 'or'. Merging the 12-month frequency limit into subclause (II) contradicts the statutory provision allowing inspection 'at any time'.

The proposed edit only populates the optional action and action_quote fields where the existing draft summary already fully conveys the inspection authority. Filling empty optional action fields alone does not address a defect or add necessary meaning, and is therefore unsupported.
